title: Heroes of Making Magic III
statementMd:
I’m strolling on sunshine, yeah-ah! And doesn’t it feel good! Well, it certainly feels good for our Heroes of Making Magic, who are casually walking on a one-directional road, fighting imps. Imps are weak and feeble creatures and they are not good at much. However, Heroes enjoy fighting them. For fun, if nothing else.

Our Hero, Ignatius, simply adores imps. He is observing a line of imps, represented as a zero-indexed array of integers $*a*$ of length $*n*$, where $*a*_{*i*}$ denotes the number of imps at the $*i*$-th position. Sometimes, imps can appear out of nowhere. When heroes fight imps, they select a segment of the line, start at one end of the segment, and finish on the other end, without ever exiting the segment. They can move exactly one cell left or right from their current position and when they do so, they defeat one imp on the cell that they moved to, so, the number of imps on that cell decreases by one. This also applies when heroes appear at one end of the segment, at the beginning of their walk.

Their goal is to defeat all imps on the segment, without ever moving to an empty cell in it (without imps), since they would get bored. Since Ignatius loves imps, he doesn’t really want to fight them, so no imps are harmed during the events of this task. However, he would like you to tell him whether it would be possible for him to clear a certain segment of imps in the above mentioned way if he wanted to.

You are given $*q*$ queries, which have two types:

- $1$ $*a*$ $*b*$ $*k*$ — denotes that $*k*$ imps appear at each cell from the interval $[*a*, *b*]$
- $2$ $*a*$ $*b*$ - asks whether Ignatius could defeat all imps on the interval $[*a*, *b*]$ in the way described above

## Input

The first line contains a single integer $*n*$ ($1 ≤ *n* ≤ 200 000$), the length of the array $*a*$. The following line contains $*n*$ integers $*a*_{1}, *a*_{2}, ..., *a*_{*n*}$ ($0 ≤ *a*_{*i*} ≤ 5 000$), the initial number of imps in each cell. The third line contains a single integer $*q*$ ($1 ≤ *q* ≤ 300 000$), the number of queries. The remaining $*q*$ lines contain one query each. Each query is provided by integers $*a*$, $*b*$ and, possibly, $*k*$ ($0 ≤ *a* ≤ *b* < *n*$, $0 ≤ *k* ≤ 5 000$).

## Output

For each second type of query output $1$ if it is possible to clear the segment, and $0$ if it is not.

## Note

For the first query, one can easily check that it is indeed impossible to get from the first to the last cell while clearing everything. After we add 1 to the second position, we can clear the segment, for example by moving in the following way: ![image](https://espresso.codeforces.com/d02f7e30dbba09ed3edaa4c8a24a17dc85d1482c.png).
statementZhMd:
我漫步在阳光下，耶啊！感觉真不错！对于我们的施展魔法的英雄们来说，感觉当然也很棒。他们悠闲地走在一条单向道路上，与小鬼战斗。小鬼是弱小而无力的生物，不太擅长任何事情。不过，英雄们喜欢和它们战斗。至少是为了娱乐。

我们的英雄 Ignatius 非常喜爱小鬼。他正在观察一列小鬼，这些小鬼由一个长度为 $*n*$ 的零下标整数数组 $*a*$ 表示，其中 $*a*_{*i*}$ 表示第 $*i*$ 个位置上的小鬼数量。有时，小鬼会凭空出现。当英雄们与小鬼战斗时，他们会选择道路上的一个区间，从区间的一端出发，在不离开该区间的情况下走到另一端。他们每次只能从当前位置向左或向右移动一个单元格，并且移动时会击败所到达单元格中的一个小鬼，因此该单元格中的小鬼数量会减一。这同样适用于英雄们在行走开始时出现在区间某一端的情况。

他们的目标是消灭区间内的所有小鬼，并且在此过程中不能走到区间内的空单元格（没有小鬼的单元格），因为那样他们会感到无聊。由于 Ignatius 喜爱小鬼，他其实并不想与它们战斗，因此本题过程中不会有小鬼受到伤害。不过，如果他愿意，他希望你告诉他，是否能够按照上述方式清空某个区间内的小鬼。

给定 $*q*$ 个查询，查询有以下两种类型：

- $1$ $*a*$ $*b*$ $*k*$ —— 表示区间 $[*a*, *b*]$ 中的每个单元格都出现 $*k*$ 个小鬼。
- $2$ $*a*$ $*b*$ —— 询问 Ignatius 是否能够按照上述方式消灭区间 $[*a*, *b*]$ 内的所有小鬼。

## 输入格式

第一行包含一个整数 $*n*$（$1 ≤ *n* ≤ 200 000$），表示数组 $*a*$ 的长度。下一行包含 $*n*$ 个整数 $*a*_{1}, *a*_{2}, ..., *a*_{*n*}$（$0 ≤ *a*_{*i*} ≤ 5 000$），表示每个单元格中初始的小鬼数量。第三行包含一个整数 $*q*$（$1 ≤ *q* ≤ 300 000$），表示查询数量。接下来的 $*q*$ 行每行包含一个查询。每个查询由整数 $*a*$、$*b*$ 以及可能存在的 $*k*$ 给出（$0 ≤ *a* ≤ *b* < *n*$，$0 ≤ *k* ≤ 5 000$）。

## 输出格式

对于每个第二类查询，如果可以清空该区间，输出 $1$；否则输出 $0$。

## 说明

对于第一个查询，可以很容易地验证，在清空所有小鬼的同时从第一个单元格走到最后一个单元格确实是不可能的。在第二个位置加上 1 后，就可以清空该区间，例如按照以下方式移动：![image](https://espresso.codeforces.com/d02f7e30dbba09ed3edaa4c8a24a17dc85d1482c.png)。
